title: ai-playbook rule frontmatter (v1)
description: Frontmatter contract for docs/rules/<slug>.rule.md. Disjoint with schema-concept-v1.json per D9.

schema.description: Schema versioning hook. MUST be 'rule/v1' for this version.

slug.description: Authoritative identifier; filename derives from slug, not the reverse.

description.description: One-line summary used as the routing key for Cursor agent-requested activation.

oneOf.description: Path to the L1 Python hook implementing this rule.

activation.description: Cursor 4-mode loading semantics. See docs/concepts/cross-llm-activation.md for per-LLM degradation.

status.description: Declarative lifecycle state. 'deprecated' triggers a removal-window banner per D18.

globs.description: File-pattern scoping (Cursor co-constraint: REQUIRED when activation=auto).

triggers.description: Hook dispatcher routing key per D10. Empty = always fires.

env.description: Canonical bypass env var. Audited to <consumer>/.ai-playbook-state/break-glass-audit.jsonl.

rule_bundle.description: Optional bundle name for multi-step rules grouped under docs/rules/<bundle>/.

last_validated.description: D21 — optional freshness signal (YYYY-MM-DD); >180d ago triggers a warn-only freshness check.
